faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I am a 4th-year college student and full-time AI Engineer & Web Developer. Having completed 4 internships and won 4 hackathons, I specialize in applied Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, scalable Full-Stack Web Development (Next.js, React, Node.js, Python), and building high-performance software systems.

faqData.q: Are you available for research or freelance collaborations?
faqData.a: Yes! Alongside my full-time work as an AI Engineer, I am always excited to connect for innovative freelance projects, hackathons, and technical initiatives where AI and modern web technologies intersect.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack for production?
faqData.a: For AI projects, I primarily use Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and FastAPI. For web applications, my stack centers on Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, backed by Node.js or Python microservices and PostgreSQL.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with enterprise or production projects?
faqData.a: Yes, through 4 technical internships and my current full-time AI Engineer position, I have worked on production-grade machine learning pipelines, scalable backend microservices, and high-performance web applications.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at kritagyajaiswal@gmail.com. I'm usually able to respond within 24 hours to discuss how my technical skills can add value to your initiatives.
